label: prf:descartes
title: Proof of Descartes theorem
html:
Existence. By QU-to-QOU lifting and genus-maximal descent, the base curve is a smooth genus-4 curve \Sigma with \chi(\Sigma) = -6. The Hurwitz bound gives \lvert\mathrm{Aut}(\Sigma)\rvert \leq 252; among genus-4 curves, Bring's surface achieves the maximum \lvert S_5\rvert = 120 (Edge, 1978), and the S_5-equivariant structure uniquely determines \Sigma_4 \subset \mathbb{P}^4_R. The descent data (branch locus with 6 points, S_5-symmetric ramification) defines a map \Sigma \to \Sigma_4, extending to a QOU morphism by functoriality of the Haar state on \mathcal{O}_q(\mathrm{SU}(2)).

Uniqueness. By Tannaka--Krein rigidity, any two fibre-preserving monoidal functors between Tannakian categories are correspondingly isomorphic.
